title: I don't want to go yet.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I don't want to go yet.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Can I wear the boots? I don't want to bend down.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Boots it is. Two minutes, then we go.

variations: "go" 换 "get dressed"；"bend down" 换 "tie laces"。
